tools.name: start_quote
tools.description: Start a homeowners or landlord insurance quote for a property in California. Collect every field from the user first. Ask for the date of birth as typed text, not with a date picker: picking a birth year decades back in a calendar is hard. Before calling, tell the user that DwellQuote and its partne

tools.name: get_property_details
tools.description: Returns what DwellQuote found about the property. This call waits for the lookup, which usually takes under 30 seconds; if status is still "collecting", tell the user you are still looking and call it again right away. When status is "ready", show the user the property facts and ask them to confirm

tools.name: submit_property_details
tools.description: Submit the property facts the user confirmed and request quotes from DwellQuote's carriers. Send every field the user confirmed, not only the ones they changed. Call this once per quote; then poll get_quotes.

tools.name: get_quotes
tools.description: Returns the quotes for a property. This call waits for the carriers, which usually takes under a minute; if status is still "quoting", tell the user quotes are still coming in and call it again right away. When status is "complete", show every rate exactly as returned, cheapest first, with its cover

tools.name: select_quote
tools.description: Record the rate the user chose and get the link where they finish on dwellquote.com. Give the user finish_url and explain that they will confirm their email there, and that a licensed advisor from Somerset Agency will then contact them to confirm the final rate and bind the policy. The link expires

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "start_quote" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Start a homeowners or landlord insurance quote for a property in California. Collect every field from the user first. Ask for the date of birth as typed text, n…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: select_quote · Private data: get_quotes, select_quote · Public sink: submit_property_details, get_quotes, select_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: select_quote · Private data: get_quotes, select_quote · Public sink: submit_property_details, get_quotes, select_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
